title: Line interpolation writes duplicate point indices during animation
reason: The sole comment confirms #10247 assigns each converged start point its own id and index, fixing duplicate point indices and key/index mismatch in animated frames.

varveAssessment.assessment: The upstream line interpolation fix does not establish an analogous Varve defect.

title: Can temporarily navigate back to a deleted file/file in a deleted workspace
reason: A browser Back action briefly reveals a file after its workspace was deleted, before the route settles to the deleted-file state. The sole reply discusses soft-delete as a possible solution if hard deletion is lazy; no resolution is confirmed.

varveAssessment.assessment: This depends on upstream hosted workspace deletion and history routing, absent from Varve's local-first editor.

title: Sidebar "Older" group is confusing when shown without earlier time groups
reason: Reports that the upstream time-group label "Older" lacks context when search leaves only older files visible. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's project/file navigation is a separate product surface; no local copy change follows from this report.

title: Add a user preferences modal to tldraw.com
reason: Requests a dedicated upstream account preferences dialog for display name, presence color, and editor preferences currently spread across sidebar controls. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's settings dialog and local identity preferences have different requirements; no defect was inferred.

title: Investigate other options for link shortcuts
reason: The comments agree that overloading Cmd/Ctrl+K may be undesirable while still wanting to compare conventions in other tools. No decision or replacement shortcut is recorded.

varveAssessment.assessment: Shortcut changes require Varve's command map and discoverability review; upstream discussion does not resolve a local need.

title: Add an action to reverse an arrow's direction by swapping its ends
reason: Requests a command that swaps an arrow's bound start and end shapes while preserving geometry, reversing the arrow direction. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potentially useful for diagramming, but Varve arrow binding and command semantics were not inspected in this assessment.

title: Move development to tldraw-dev repo
reason: Discusses splitting the upstream public SDK repository from its internal monorepo and moving development to a new repository. This is an organization/repository strategy proposal.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve code or product change is indicated.

title: ForgeCat profile for tldraw
reason: The profile author offered to remove their integration; the maintainer requested removal, and the follow-up confirms removal from the profile repository and unpublication of the registry package. No acceptance or endorsement is implied.

varveAssessment.assessment: The third-party profile is explicitly removed and provides no Varve implementation requirement.

title: Automatically delete empty files after 4 hours on tldraw.com
reason: Requests background permanent deletion of upstream hosted files with no title/content after four hours. This is a destructive service data-retention policy and no discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No hosted service or auto-delete policy exists in Varve's local-first workspace; do not translate this into local file deletion.

title: License expiry is compared inconsistently across timezones, expiring up to a day early
reason: Explains that date-only expiry strings are parsed as UTC then compared through local date getters, potentially expiring licenses early west of UTC. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Searched Varve expiry paths: entitlements use numeric `expiresAt` timestamps, and no `expiryDate` date-only license comparison exists. No analogous timezone bug was found.
